description: Source code for micro:bit specific hooks and hardware interaction in a Zephyr-based Bluetooth mesh project, including button handling, display updates, and sound generation.

methods.name: button_send_pressed
methods.description: Handles the event when the button is pressed, triggers a board-specific action.

methods.name: button_pressed
methods.description: Callback for GPIO button press, updates display and submits work.

methods.name: get_period
methods.description: Returns the period for a musical note, considering sharp notes.

methods.name: board_play_tune
methods.description: Plays a tune based on a string of digits and notes, controlling PWM for sound.

methods.name: board_heartbeat
methods.description: Displays heartbeat status with a visual pattern based on hops.

methods.name: board_other_dev_pressed
methods.description: Displays the address of another device when pressed.

methods.name: board_attention
methods.description: Displays an attention indicator on the display.

methods.name: configure_button
methods.description: Configures a GPIO button with interrupt.

methods.name: board_init
methods.description: Initializes hardware, display, and sets device address.
